title_en: Optimality of FSQ Tokens for Continuous Diffusion for Categorical Data with Application to Text-to-Speech
title_zh: 面向分类数据的连续扩散的FSQ词元最优性及其在语音合成中的应用

sentences.en: Continuous diffusion for categorical data is a framework belonging to the diffusion family and aiming at generating discrete data.
sentences.zh: 面向分类数据的连续扩散是扩散家族中的一个框架，旨在生成离散数据。

sentences.en: The scientific interest to such models has been constantly increasing these days because researchers try to achieve a challenging goal of finding reasonable alternatives to autoregressive large language models.
sentences.zh: 近来，研究者对这类模型的科学兴趣持续增长，因为他们试图实现一个具有挑战性的目标：寻找自回归大语言模型的合理替代方案。

sentences.en: In this paper, we study the properties of the structure of the latent space corresponding to discrete tokens expressed in terms of Kullback-Leibler divergence on diffusion path measures and accuracy of the correct token prediction by the optimally trained diffusion model.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们研究与离散词元对应的潜在空间结构的性质，用扩散路径测度上的Kullback-Leibler散度以及最优训练的扩散模型正确预测词元的准确度来表述。

sentences.en: We find that FSQ tokenization scheme has the latent space structure with the properties that make it best suited for continuous diffusion for categorical data as verified through rigorous theoretical analysis and numerical experiments.
sentences.zh: 我们发现FSQ词元化方案具有使潜在空间结构最适合面向分类数据的连续扩散的性质，这通过严谨的理论分析和数值实验得以验证。

sentences.en: To validate our findings in real-life scenario, we train several text-to-speech diffusion models having speech tokens as intermediate acoustic features, and show that the one based on FSQ tokens indeed performs the best, and, moreover, it outperforms its strong LLM-based counterpart, at the same time being significantly smaller and faster.
sentences.zh: 为在现实场景中验证我们的发现，我们训练了若干以语音词元作为中间声学特征的语音合成扩散模型，并表明基于FSQ词元的模型确实表现最佳，且它还超越其基于LLM的强对应模型，同时显著更小、更快。

title_en: Optimization Dynamics of Equivariant and Augmented Neural Networks
title_zh: 等变与增强神经网络的最优化动力学

sentences.en: We investigate the optimization of neural networks on symmetric data, and compare the strategy of constraining the architecture to be equivariant to that of using data augmentation.
sentences.zh: 我们研究对称数据上神经网络的优化，并比较将架构约束为等变与使用数据增强这两种策略。

sentences.en: Our analysis reveals that the relative geometry of the admissible and the equivariant layers, respectively, plays a key role.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析揭示，可容许层与等变层的相对几何分别起着关键作用。

sentences.en: Under natural assumptions on the data, network, loss, and group of symmetries, we show that compatibility of the spaces of admissible layers and equivariant layers, in the sense that the corresponding orthogonal projections commute, implies that the sets of equivariant stationary points are identical for the two strategies.
sentences.zh: 在对数据、网络、损失和对称群的自然假设下，我们表明，若可容许层空间与等变层空间相容（在相应正交投影可交换的意义上），那么两种策略的等变驻点集是相同的。

sentences.en: If the linear layers of the network also are given a unitary parametrization, the set of equivariant layers is even invariant under the gradient flow for augmented models.
sentences.zh: 如果网络的线性层还赋予酉参数化，那么即使对增强模型，等变层集在梯度流下也是不变的。

sentences.en: Our analysis however also reveals that even in the latter situation, stationary points may be unstable for augmented training although they are stable for the manifestly equivariant models.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们的分析也揭示，即使在后者情形中，驻点对增强训练可能是不稳定的，尽管它们对显式等变模型是稳定的。

title_en: Optimization with Access to Auxiliary Information
title_zh: 可访问辅助信息下的优化

sentences.en: We investigate the fundamental optimization question of minimizing a \emph{target} function $f(x)$, whose gradients are expensive to compute or have limited availability, given access to some \emph{auxiliary} side function $h(x)$ whose gradients are cheap or more available.
sentences.zh: 我们研究这样一个基本优化问题：在可以访问某个\emph{辅助}侧函数 $h(x)$（其梯度便宜或更容易获得）的情况下，最小化一个梯度计算昂贵或可用性有限的\emph{目标}函数 $f(x)$。

sentences.en: This formulation captures many settings of practical relevance, such as i) re-using batches in SGD, ii) transfer learning, iii) federated learning, iv) training with compressed models/dropout, etcetera.
sentences.zh: 这一表述捕捉了许多具有实际意义的设定，例如i）在SGD中重用批次，ii）迁移学习，iii）联邦学习，iv）用压缩模型/随机失活训练，等等。

sentences.en: We propose two generic new algorithms that apply in all these settings; we also prove that we can benefit from this framework under the Hessian similarity assumption between the target and side information.
sentences.zh: 我们提出两个适用于所有这些设定的通用新算法；我们还证明，在目标信息与侧信息之间的Hessian相似性假设下，我们能从这一框架中获益。

sentences.en: A benefit is obtained when this similarity measure is small; we also show a potential benefit from stochasticity when the auxiliary noise is correlated with that of the target function.
sentences.zh: 当这一相似性度量较小时可获得收益；我们还表明，当辅助噪声与目标函数噪声相关时，随机性可能带来潜在收益。

title_en: Optimization,  Generalization and Differential Privacy Bounds for Gradient Descent on Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks
title_zh: Kolmogorov–Arnold网络上梯度下降的优化、泛化与差分隐私界

sentences.en: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have recently emerged as a structured alternative to standard MLPs, yet a principled theory for their training dynamics, generalization, and privacy properties remains limited.
sentences.zh: Kolmogorov–Arnold网络（KANs）近期已成为标准MLP的一种结构化替代方案，但对其训练动力学、泛化和隐私性质的理论研究仍然有限。

sentences.en: In this paper, we analyze gradient descent (GD) for training two-layer KANs and derive general bounds that characterize their training dynamics, generalization, and utility under differential privacy (DP).
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们分析训练两层KAN的梯度下降（GD），并推导刻画其训练动力学、泛化以及差分隐私（DP）下效用的通用界。

sentences.en: As a concrete instantiation, we specialize our analysis to logistic loss under an NTK-separable assumption, where we show that polylogarithmic network width suffices for GD to achieve an optimization rate of order $1/T$ and a generalization rate of order $1/n$, with $T$ denoting the number of GD iterations and $n$ the sample size.
sentences.zh: 作为一个具体实例，我们在NTK可分离假设下将分析特化到logistic损失，其中我们表明，多项对数级网络宽度足以使GD实现 $1/T$ 阶的优化速率和 $1/n$ 阶的泛化速率，其中 $T$ 表示GD迭代次数，$n$ 表示样本量。

sentences.en: In the private setting, we characterize the noise required for $(\epsilon,\delta)$-DP and obtain a utility bound of order $\sqrt{d}/(n\epsilon)$ (with $d$ the input dimension), matching the classical lower bound for general convex Lipschitz problems.
sentences.zh: 在私有设定中，我们刻画 $(\epsilon,\delta)$-DP 所需的噪声，并得到 $√d/(nε)$ 阶的效用界（其中 $d$ 为输入维度），匹配一般凸Lipschitz问题的经典下界。

sentences.en: Our results imply that polylogarithmic width is not only sufficient but also necessary under differential privacy, revealing a qualitative gap between non-private (sufficiency only) and private (necessity also emerges) training regimes.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果意味着，多项对数级宽度在无差分隐私下是最充分的，在差分隐私下则不仅是充分的而且是必要的，揭示了非私有训练（仅充分性）与私有训练（还出现必要性）之间的定性差距。

sentences.en: Experiments further illustrate how these theoretical insights can guide practical choices, including network width selection and early stopping.
sentences.zh: 实验进一步说明这些理论洞见如何指导实际选择，包括网络宽度选择和提前停止。

title_en: Optimized Deferral for Imbalanced Settings
title_zh: 不平衡情形下的优化推迟

sentences.en: Learning algorithms can be significantly improved by routing complex or uncertain inputs to specialized experts, balancing accuracy with computational cost.
sentences.zh: 通过将复杂或不确定的输入路由到专业专家，学习算法可以得到显著改进，在准确性与计算成本之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: This approach, known as *learning to defer*, is essential in domains like natural language generation, medical diagnosis, and computer vision, where an effective deferral can reduce errors at low extra resource consumption.
sentences.zh: 这种方法称为*学习推迟*，在自然语言生成、医学诊断和计算机视觉等领域至关重要，因为有效的推迟能在低额外资源消耗下减少错误。

sentences.en: However, the two-stage learning to defer setting, which leverages existing predictors such as a collection of LLMs or other classifiers, often faces challenges due to an expert imbalance problem.
sentences.zh: 然而，利用现有预测器（如一批LLM或其他分类器）的两阶段学习推迟设定，常常因专家不平衡问题而面临挑战。

sentences.en: This imbalance can lead to suboptimal performance, with deferral algorithms favoring the majority expert.
sentences.zh: 这种不平衡可能导致次优性能，使推迟算法偏向多数专家。

sentences.en: We present a comprehensive study of two-stage learning to defer in expert imbalance settings.
sentences.zh: 我们呈现对专家不平衡设定中两阶段学习推迟的全面研究。

sentences.en: We cast the deferral loss optimization as a novel cost-sensitive learning problem over the input-expert domain.
sentences.zh: 我们将推迟损失优化构建为输入-专家域上的一个新的代价敏感学习问题。

sentences.en: We derive new margin-based loss functions and guarantees tailored to this setting, and develop novel algorithms for cost-sensitive learning.
sentences.zh: 我们为该设定推导新的基于边距的损失函数和保证，并开发代价敏感学习的新算法。

sentences.en: Leveraging these results, we design principled deferral algorithms, MILD (*Margin-based Imbalanced Learning to Defer*), specifically suited for expert imbalance settings.
sentences.zh: 利用这些结果，我们设计了有原则的推迟算法MILD（*基于边距的不平衡学习推迟*），特别适合专家不平衡设定。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, showing clear improvements over existing baselines on both image classification and real-world Large Language Model (LLM) routing tasks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验展示了我们方法的有效性，在图像分类和真实世界大语言模型（LLM）路由任务上都显示出对现有基线的明显改进。

title_en: Optimizing Agentic Reasoning with Retrieval via Synthetic Semantic Information Gain Reward
title_zh: 通过合成语义信息增益奖励优化带检索的智能体推理

sentences.en: Agentic reasoning enables large reasoning models (LRMs) to dynamically acquire external knowledge, yet optimizing the retrieval process remains challenging due to the lack of dense, principled reward signals.
sentences.zh: 智能体推理使大推理模型（LRMs）能够动态获取外部知识，但由于缺乏稠密且有原则的奖励信号，优化检索过程仍具挑战性。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce *InfoReasoner*, a unified framework that incentivizes effective information seeking via a *synthetic semantic information gain reward*.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入*InfoReasoner*，一个通过*合成语义信息增益奖励*激励有效信息搜寻的统一框架。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we redefine information gain as uncertainty reduction over the model's belief states, establishing key properties including non-negativity, telescoping additivity, and channel monotonicity.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们将信息增益重新定义为模型信念状态上的不确定性缩减，建立非负性、望远镜加性和通道单调性等关键性质。

sentences.en: Practically, to enable scalable optimization without manual intermediate retrieval annotations, we instantiate this principle as a semantic information gain reward computed from the model's output distributions using *semantic clustering via bidirectional textual entailment*.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，为在无手动中间检索标注的情况下实现可扩展优化，我们将这一原则实例化为一种语义信息增益奖励，通过*双向文本蕴含的语义聚类*从模型的输出分布计算。

sentences.en: This training reward provides dense credit for retrieval steps while remaining anchored to final-answer correctness, enabling efficient training via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).
sentences.zh: 该训练奖励为检索步骤提供稠密信用，同时保持锚定于最终答案的正确性，从而能通过分组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行高效训练。

sentences.en: Experiments on seven question-answering benchmarks, MATH500, and WebDetective show consistent gains over strong retrieval-augmented baselines, supporting our dense semantic information gain as a practical training signal for agentic retrieval.
sentences.zh: 在七个问答基准、MATH500和WebDetective上的实验显示，相比强检索增强基线有持续收益，支持将我我的稠密语义信息增益作为智能体检索的实际训练信号。

title_en: Optimizing Diversity and Quality through Base-Aligned Model Collaboration
title_zh: 通过基座对齐模型协作优化多样性与质量

sentences.en: Alignment has greatly improved large language models (LLMs)' output quality at the cost of diversity, yielding highly similar outputs across generations, especially in open-ended generation tasks.
sentences.zh: 对齐以多样性为代价大幅提升了大语言模型（LLMs）的输出质量，导致不同生成之间产生高度相似的输出，尤其是在开放式生成任务中。

sentences.en: We propose Base-Aligned Model Collaboration (BACo), an inference-time token-level model collaboration framework that dynamically combines a base LLM with its aligned counterpart to optimize diversity and quality.
sentences.zh: 我们提出基座对齐模型协作（BACo），一种推理时的词元级模型协作框架，动态地将基座LLM与其对齐对应物相结合，以优化多样性和质量。

sentences.en: Using uncertainty and content-based signals, BACo employs routing strategies to determine, at each token, which model to decode from.
sentences.zh: 利用不确定性和基于内容的信号，BACo采用路由策略，在每个词元处决定从哪个模型解码。

sentences.en: Prior diversity-promoting methods often improve diversity at the expense of quality or require expensive decoding or post-training.
sentences.zh: 先前的多样性提升方法常常以质量下降为代价改进多样性，或者需要昂贵的解码或后训练。

sentences.en: In contrast, BACo achieves both high diversity and quality post hoc within a single pass, while offering strong controllability.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，BACo在单次前向中事后同时实现高多样性和高质量，并提供强可控性。

sentences.en: We introduce a family of effective routing strategies and evaluate them across three open-ended generation tasks with 13 diversity and quality metrics.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一系列有效的路由策略，并在三个开放式生成任务上用13个多样性与质量指标进行评估。

sentences.en: BACo consistently surpasses state-of-the-art inference-time baselines.
sentences.zh: BACo一致地超越最先进的推理时基线。

sentences.en: With our best router, BACo achieves a 21.3% joint improvement in diversity and quality, which is further supported by human evaluations.
sentences.zh: 借助我们最佳的路由器，BACo在多样性和质量上获得21.3%的联合改进，这进一步得到人类评估的支持。

sentences.en: Overall, our results demonstrate that collaboration between base and aligned models provides an effective and controllable mechanism for optimizing the diversity-quality trade-off.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果证明，基座模型与对齐模型之间的协作为优化多样性-质量权衡提供了一种有效且可控的机制。

title_en: Optimizing Few-Step Generation with Adaptive Matching Distillation
title_zh: 用自适应匹配蒸馏优化少步生成

sentences.en: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) is a powerful acceleration paradigm, yet its stability is often compromised in **Forbidden Zones**—regions where the real teacher provides unreliable guidance while the fake teacher exerts insufficient repulsive force.
sentences.zh: 分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）是一种强大的加速范式，但其稳定性常在**禁区**（真实教师提供不可靠引导而假教师斥力不足的区域）中受损。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a unified optimization framework that reinterprets prior art as implicit strategies to avoid these corrupted regions.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一个统一优化框架，将先前工作重新解释为避免这些受损区域的隐式策略。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we introduce Adaptive Matching Distillation (**AMD**), a self-correcting mechanism that utilizes reward proxies to explicitly detect and escape Forbidden Zones.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们引入自适应匹配蒸馏（**AMD**），一种利用奖励代理显式检测并逃离禁区的自纠正机制。

sentences.en: AMD dynamically prioritizes corrective gradients via structural signal decomposition and introduces Repulsive Landscape Sharpening to enforce steep energy barriers against failure mode collapse.
sentences.zh: AMD通过结构信号分解动态优先纠正梯度，并引入斥力景观锐化，以施加陡峭能垒防止失败模式崩塌。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across image and video generation tasks (e.g., SDXL, Wan2.1) and rigorous benchmarks (e.g., VBench, GenEval) demonstrate that AMD significantly enhances sample fidelity and training robustness.
sentences.zh: 在图像和视频生成任务（例如SDXL、Wan2.1）以及严格基准（例如VBench、GenEval）上的大量实验表明，AMD显著提升样本保真度和训练鲁棒性。

sentences.en: For instance, AMD improves the HPSv2 score on SDXL from **30.64** to **31.25**, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 例如，AMD将SDXL上的HPSv2分数从**30.64**提升到**31.25**，超越最先进的基线。

sentences.en: These findings validate that explicitly rectifying optimization trajectories within Forbidden Zones is essential for pushing the performance ceiling of few-step generative models.
sentences.zh: 这些发现验证了，在禁区内显式纠正优化轨迹对于推动少步生成模型的性能上限至关重要。

title_en: Optimizing Inference-Time Compute for Medical Reasoning via Uncertainty Quantification
title_zh: 通过不确定性量化优化医学推理的推理时计算

sentences.en: Extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly bolstered the capabilities of medical large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 扩展思维链（CoT）推理显著增强了医学大语言模型（LLMs）的能力。

sentences.en: However, current models exhibit static computational expenditure, applying lengthy reasoning processes indiscriminately to both simple queries and complex diagnostic cases.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前模型表现出静态的计算开销，对简单查询和复杂诊断病例不加区分地应用冗长的推理过程。

sentences.en: This inefficiency is particularly prohibitive in real-world healthcare, where clinical scenarios range from time-sensitive emergencies requiring rapid response to intricate pathologies demanding deep analysis.
sentences.zh: 这种低效在现实医疗保健中尤其不利，因为临床场景既包括需要快速响应的时间敏感紧急情况，也包括需要深入分析的复杂病理。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose **AdaThink-Med**, an end-to-end framework for adaptive reasoning via uncertainty-guided length calibration.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一点，我们提出**AdaThink-Med**，一个通过不确定性引导的长度校准进行自适应推理的端到端框架。

sentences.en: Although the underlying mechanism is generalizable, we demonstrate its critical value in the medical domain, where balancing inference latency with diagnostic precision is paramount.
sentences.zh: 虽然底层机制具有通用性，我们展示了其在医学领域的关键价值，因为在该领域，平衡推理延迟与诊断精度至关重要。

sentences.en: AdaThink-Med leverages entropy-based uncertainty estimation within reinforcement fine-tuning to dynamically shape reward signals: it penalizes verbosity for high-confidence correct answers (e.g., straightforward knowledge retrieval) while incentivizing extended exploration for uncertain or ambiguous scenarios.
sentences.zh: AdaThink-Med利用强化微调中的熵基不确定性估计动态塑造奖励信号：对高置信度正确答案（例如直接的知识检索）惩罚冗长，同时激励对不确定或模糊场景进行扩展探索。

sentences.en: Across six medical benchmarks, AdaThink-Med reduces inference token consumption by **4.7× to 6.4×** on Qwen and Llama architectures, respectively, with minimal performance trade-offs.
sentences.zh: 在六个医学基准上，AdaThink-Med在Qwen和Llama架构上分别将推理词元消耗减少**4.7倍至6.4倍**，且性能权衡极小。

sentences.en: Notably, our reward design naturally produces distinct "non-thinking" and "thinking" modes within a single model, enabling efficient allocation of computational resources without any external router or classifier.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们的奖励设计在单一模型内自然地产生不同的“非思考”和“思考”模式，无需任何外部路由器或分类器即可实现计算资源的高效分配。

title_en: Optimizing Network Simulation: Enhancing Performance Prediction Accuracy via Neural Architecture Search
title_zh: 优化网络仿真：通过神经架构搜索提升性能预测准确度

sentences.en: Existing machine learning models for network simulation excel at predicting average performance but, due to their reliance on mean squared error, systematically fail to capture the critical tail-latency and jitter that define modern network stability.
sentences.zh: 用于网络仿真的现有机器学习模型擅长预测平均性能，但由于依赖均方误差，它们系统性地无法捕捉定义现代网络稳定性的关键尾部延迟和抖动。

sentences.en: This 'tail-blindness' renders them unreliable for latency-sensitive systems.
sentences.zh: 这种“尾部盲区”使它们对延迟敏感系统不可靠。

sentences.en: We bridge this gap by introducing Accurate Neural Architecture Search (ANAS), a paradigm that automates the discovery of architectures for high-precision, distribution-aware network simulation.
sentences.zh: 我们通过引入精确神经架构搜索（ANAS）来弥合这一差距，这是一种自动化发现高精度、分布感知网络仿真架构的范式。

sentences.en: ANAS corrects the evaluation inaccuracies of weight-sharing NAS via a similarity-constrained search, employs a hybrid search space to model complex traffic, and uses a Wasserstein loss to optimize for the entire delay distribution, not just its mean.
sentences.zh: ANAS通过相似性约束搜索纠正权重共享NAS的评估不准确，采用混合搜索空间对复杂流量建模，并使用Wasserstein损失优化整个延迟分布而不只是其均值。

sentences.en: Empirically, the ANAS-discovered architecture is holistically superior: it reduces overall validation loss by 25.8\% compared to DeepQueueNet, demonstrating strong average-case performance, while simultaneously excelling at tail-sensitive metrics by lowering the normalized Wasserstein distance ($W_n$) by up to 69.8\%.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，ANAS发现的架构在整体上更优：相比DeepQueueNet，它使整体验证损失降低25.8\%，展现出强平均情形性能，同时通过将归一化Wasserstein距离（$W_n$）最多降低69.8\%，在尾部敏感指标上同样出色。

sentences.en: This confirms its ability to faithfully model a comprehensive performance spectrum, encompassing both average and critical tail behaviors.
sentences.zh: 这确证了它能够忠实地刻画涵盖平均与关键尾部行为的全面性能谱。

sentences.en: The ANAS framework provides a practical methodology for automatically creating high-fidelity model of network devices, enabling more reliable validation of next-generation network protocols and algorithms.
sentences.zh: ANAS框架为自动创建高保真网络设备模型提供了一种实用方法，使下一代网络协议和算法能得到更可靠的验证。

title_en: Optimizing Rank for High-Fidelity Implicit Neural Representations
title_zh: 为高保真隐式神经表示优化秩

sentences.en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) based on vanilla Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) are widely believed to be incapable of representing high-frequency content.
sentences.zh: 基于朴素多层感知机（MLPs）的隐式神经表示（INRs）被广泛认为无法表示高频内容。

sentences.en: This has directed research efforts towards architectural interventions, such as coordinate embeddings or specialized activation functions, to represent high-frequency signals.
sentences.zh: 这促使研究努力转向架构干预，例如坐标嵌入或专门的激活函数，以表示高频信号。

sentences.en: In this paper, we challenge the notion that the low-frequency bias of vanilla MLPs is an intrinsic, architectural limitation to learn high-frequency content, but instead a symptom of stable rank degradation during training.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们质疑朴素MLP的低频偏好是学习高频内容的内在架构局限这一观点，而认为它是训练期间稳定秩退化的一个症状。

sentences.en: We empirically demonstrate that regulating the network’s rank during training substantially improves the fidelity of the learned signal, rendering even simple MLP architectures expressive.
sentences.zh: 我们在实证上表明，在训练期间调控网络的秩能显著提升所学信号的保真度，甚至使简单的MLP架构也具有表达能力。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that using optimizers like Muon, with high-rank, near-orthogonal updates, consistently enhances INR architectures even beyond simple ReLU MLPs.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，使用Muon等具有高秩、近似正交更新的优化器，能一致地增强INR架构，甚至超越简单的ReLU MLP。

sentences.en: These substantial improvements hold across a diverse range of domains, including natural and medical images and novel view synthesis, with up to +9 dB PSNR over the samearchitecture.
sentences.zh: 这些显著改进在自然图像、医学图像和新视角合成等不同领域都成立，相比同架构最多提升+9 dB PSNR。

sentences.en: Code is available [here](https://rank-inrs.github.io/).
sentences.zh: 代码见[此处](https://rank-inrs.github.io/)。

title_en: Optimizing Return Distributions with Distributional Dynamic Programming
title_zh: 用分布性动态规划优化收益分布

sentences.en: We introduce distributional dynamic programming (DP) methods for optimizing statistical functionals of the return distribution, with standard reinforcement learning as a special case.
sentences.zh: 我们引入分布性动态规划（DP）方法，用于优化收益分布的统计泛函，标准强化学习是其中的特例。

sentences.en: Previous distributional DP methods could optimize the same class of expected utilities as classic DP.
sentences.zh: 先前的分布性DP方法只能优化与经典DP相同的期望效用类别。

sentences.en: To go beyond, we combine distributional DP with stock augmentation, a technique previously introduced for classic DP in the context of risk-sensitive RL, where the MDP state is augmented with a statistic of the rewards obtained since the first time step.
sentences.zh: 为超越这一限制，我们将分布性DP与股票增强相结合，股票增强是先前在风险敏感RL语境中为经典DP引入的一种技术，它将MDP状态用自第一时间步以来所获奖励的一个统计量进行增广。

sentences.en: We find that a number of recently studied problems can be formulated as stock-augmented return distribution optimization, and we show that we can use distributional DP to solve them.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，许多近期研究的问题可以被构建为股票增强收益分布优化问题，并表明我们可以用分布性DP来解决它们。

sentences.en: We analyze distributional value and policy iteration, with bounds and a study of what objectives these distributional DP methods can or cannot optimize.
sentences.zh: 我们分析分布性值迭代和策略迭代，给出界，并研究这些分布性DP方法能或不能优化哪些目标。

sentences.en: We describe a number of applications outlining how to use distributional DP to solve different stock-augmented return distribution optimization problems, for example maximizing conditional value-at-risk, and homeostatic regulation.
sentences.zh: 我们描述若干应用，概述如何使用分布性DP解决不同的股票增强收益分布优化问题，例如最大化条件风险价值和稳态调节。

sentences.en: To highlight the practical potential of stock-augmented return distribution optimization and distributional DP, we introduce an agent that combines DQN and the core ideas of distributional DP, and empirically evaluate it for solving instances of the applications discussed.
sentences.zh: 为凸显股票增强收益分布优化与分布性DP的实际潜力，我们引入一个结合DQN与分布性DP核心思想的智能体，并实证评估其在求解所讨论应用实例中的表现。

title_en: Optimizing Visual Generative Models via Distribution-wise Rewards
title_zh: 通过分布级奖励优化视觉生成模型

sentences.en: Conventional reinforcement learning strategies for visual generation typically employ sample-wise reward functions, yet this practice frequently results in reward hacking that degrades image diversity and introduces visual anomalies.
sentences.zh: 用于视觉生成的常规强化学习策略通常采用样本级奖励函数，然而这种做法常常导致奖励黑客行为，从而降低图像多样性并引入视觉异常。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we present a novel framework that finetunes generative models using distribution-wise rewards, ensuring better alignment with real-world data distributions.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们提出一个新颖框架，使用分布级奖励微调生成模型，确保与真实世界数据分布更好地对齐。

sentences.en: Unlike rewards that evaluate samples individually, distribution-wise reward accounts for the data distribution of the samples, mitigating the mode collapse problem that occurs when all samples optimize towards the same direction independently.
sentences.zh: 与逐个评估样本的奖励不同，分布级奖励考虑样本的数据分布，缓解了当所有样本独立地朝同一方向优化时出现的模式崩塌问题。

sentences.en: To overcome the prohibitive computational cost of estimating these rewards, we introduce a subset-replace strategy that efficiently provides reward signals by updating only a small subset of a generated reference set.
sentences.zh: 为克服估计这些奖励的过高计算成本，我们引入一种子集替换策略，通过仅更新生成的参考集中的一小部分来高效提供奖励信号。

sentences.en: Additionally, we apply RL to optimize post-hoc model merging coefficients, potentially mitigating the train-inference inconsistency caused by introducing stochastic differential equation (SDE) in regular RL practices.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们应用RL优化事后模型合并系数，可能缓解常规RL实践中引入随机微分方程（SDE）所造成的训练-推理不一致。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show our approach significantly improves FID-50K across various base models, from 8.30 to 5.77 for SiT and from 3.74 to 3.52 for EDM2.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法显著改善各种基座模型的FID-50K，SiT从8.30降至5.77，EDM2从3.74降至3.52。

sentences.en: Qualitative evaluation also confirms that our method enhances perceptual quality while preserving sample diversity.
sentences.zh: 定性评估也确认我们的方法在保持样本多样性的同时提升了感知质量。

title_en: OPTION: Optimal Transport–Guided Flow Matching for Incomplete and Unaligned Multi-View Clustering
title_zh: OPTION：面向不完整与未对齐多视图聚类的最优传输引导流匹配

sentences.en: Multi-view clustering effectively exploits rich information from multiple views, yet real-world applications are frequently challenged by missing views and cross-view sample misalignment, hindering cross-view modeling and resulting in inferior clustering performance.
sentences.zh: 多视图聚类有效利用了来自多个视图的丰富信息，然而现实应用常常面临视图缺失和跨视图样本不对齐的挑战，这阻碍了跨视图建模并导致较差的聚类性能。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, this paper presents a novel method, **OP**timal **T**ransport–Gu**I**ded fl**O**w Matchi**N**g for incomplete and unaligned multi-view clustering (**OPTION**).
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，本文提出一种新颖方法：面向不完整和未对齐多视图聚类的最优传输引导流匹配（**OPTION**）。

sentences.en: Specifically, OPTION employs conditional flow matching to learn deterministic transport paths for missing-view imputation, enabling stable manifold-preserving recovery and more discriminative representations.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，OPTION采用条件流匹配学习用于缺失视图插补的确定性传输路径，从而实现稳定的保流形恢复和更具判别性的表示。

sentences.en: To support alignment-free fusion, we introduce a Gromov-Wasserstein-inspired structural regularization that aligns intra-view geometric structures in the latent space without solving hard correspondences.
sentences.zh: 为支持无对齐融合，我们引入一种受Gromov-Wasserstein启发的结构正则化，在潜在空间中对齐视图内几何结构，而无需求解硬对应关系。

sentences.en: Furthermore, an optional contrastive regularization is incorporated to enhance cross-view consistency specifically for aligned settings.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还纳入一个可选的对比正则化，专门为对齐设定增强跨视图一致性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that OPTION outperforms state-of-the-art methods across ideal, incomplete, and unaligned scenarios evaluated separately.
sentences.zh: 在理想、不完整和未对齐场景中分别评估时，大量实验表明OPTION优于最先进方法。

sentences.en: Code: https://github.com/TimoZhou1024/OPTION.
sentences.zh: 代码：https://github.com/TimoZhou1024/OPTION。

title_en: OptMaster: A DAG-Based Framework for Formulation and Heuristic Discovery in Optimization
title_zh: OptMaster：一个用于优化问题建模与启发式发现的DAG框架

sentences.en: Optimization problems are fundamental across science and industry, including planning, scheduling, and resource allocation.
sentences.zh: 优化问题是科学与工业领域基础性问题，包括规划、调度和资源分配。

sentences.en: While LLMs show promise in automating optimization, they struggle to bridge the gap between real-world requirements and both mathematical formulations and effective heuristic designs.
sentences.zh: 尽管LLM在自动化优化方面展现出前景，但它们在弥合真实世界需求与数学建模及有效启发式设计之间的鸿沟上仍有困难。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the field lacks a unified framework that spans problem formulation and heuristic discovery for NP-hard settings.
sentences.zh: 此外，该领域缺乏一个横跨NP困难设定的问题建模与启发式发现的统一框架。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose OptMaster, a unified framework that spans optimization from formulation to heuristic discovery, structuring the process as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) where each node represents a candidate solution.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出OptMaster，一个从建模到启发式发现横跨优化的统一框架，将这一过程结构化为一棵有向无环图（DAG），其中每个节点代表一个候选解。

sentences.en: The DAG architecture enables cross-branch knowledge transfer when search progress stagnates.
sentences.zh: DAG架构使得搜索进展停滞时能够进行跨分支知识迁移。

sentences.en: Within each node, we further replace textual self-reflection with independently generated verification code, grounding the evaluation in deterministic computation to suppress hallucinations.
sentences.zh: 在每个节点内，我们还用独立生成的验证代码替代文本自省，将评估锚定在确定性计算上以抑制幻觉。

sentences.en: OptMaster achieves competitive performance across two optimization paradigms.
sentences.zh: OptMaster在两个优化范式上取得了有竞争力的性能。

sentences.en: In Formulation Intelligence, OptMaster achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across the three most challenging benchmarks in the field.
sentences.zh: 在建模智能方面，OptMaster在该领域最具挑战性的三个基准上达到了最先进的准确率。

sentences.en: In Heuristic Discovery, OptMaster surpasses the best known solutions on Circle Packing ($n=26, 32$) and achieves a cut of 9,590 on Gset70 with significantly reduced time and search budgets.
sentences.zh: 在启发式发现方面，OptMaster在圆堆积（$n=26, 32$）上超越了已知最佳解，并在显著缩短的时间和更小的搜索预算下于Gset70上实现了9590的割值。

title_en: OptProver: Bridging Olympiad and Optimization through Continual Training in Formal Theorem Proving
title_zh: OptProver：在形式化定理证明中通过持续训练连通奥赛与优化

sentences.en: Recent advances in formal theorem proving have focused on Olympiad-level mathematics, leaving undergraduate domains largely unexplored.
sentences.zh: 形式化定理证明的近期进展聚焦于奥运级数学，导致大学本科领域在很大程度上未被探索。

sentences.en: Optimization, fundamental to machine learning, operations research, and scientific computing, remains underserved by existing provers.
sentences.zh: 优化是机器学习、运筹学和科学计算的基础，但现有证明器对其覆盖不足。

sentences.en: Its reliance on domain-specific formalisms (convexity, optimality conditions, and algorithmic analysis) creates significant distribution shift, making naive domain transfer ineffective.
sentences.zh: 它依赖领域特定的形式体系（凸性、最优性条件和算法分析），这造成显著的分布偏移，使朴素的域迁移失效。

sentences.en: We present OptProver, a trained model that achieves robust transfer from Olympiad to undergraduate optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们提出OptProver，一个实现了从奥赛到本科优化稳健迁移的训练模型。

sentences.en: Starting from a strong Olympiad-level prover, our pipeline mitigates distribution shift through two key innovations.
sentences.zh: 从一个强奥运级证明器出发，我们的流水线通过两个关键创新缓解分布偏移。

sentences.en: First, we employ large-scale optimization-focused data curation via expert iteration.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们通过专家迭代进行大规模面向优化的数据整理。

sentences.en: Second, we introduce a specialized preference learning objective that integrates perplexity-weighted optimization with a mechanism to penalize valid but non-progressing proof steps.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们引入一个专门的偏好学习目标，将困惑度加权优化与一种惩罚有效但不推进证明步骤的机制相结合。

sentences.en: This not only addresses distribution shifts but also guides the search toward efficient trajectories.
sentences.zh: 这不仅处理了分布偏移，还将搜索引导向高效轨迹。

sentences.en: To enable rigorous evaluation, we construct a novel benchmark in Lean 4 focused on optimization.
sentences.zh: 为支持严格评估，我们在Lean 4中构建了一个聚焦优化的新基准。

sentences.en: On this benchmark, OptProver achieves state-of-the-art Pass@1 and Pass@32 among comparably sized models while maintaining competitive performance on general theorem-proving tasks, demonstrating effective domain transfer without catastrophic forgetting.
sentences.zh: 在该基准上，OptProver在最先进模型大小的比较中实现了最佳的Pass@1和Pass@32，同时在通用定理证明任务上保持有竞争力的性能，展示了无灾难性遗忘的有效域迁移。

title_en: OPUS: Towards Efficient and Principled Data Selection in Large Language Model Pre-training in Every Iteration
title_zh: OPUS：让每一轮大语言模型预训练中的数据选择更高效且有原则

sentences.en: As high-quality public text approaches exhaustion, a phenomenon known as the Data Wall—LLM pre-training is shifting from more tokens to better tokens.
sentences.zh: 随着高质量公开文本接近耗尽——这一现象被称为数据墙——LLM预训练正从更多词元转向更好词元。

sentences.en: However, existing methods either rely on heuristic static filters that ignore training dynamics, or use dynamic yet optimizer-agnostic criteria based on raw gradients.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法要么依赖忽略训练动态的启发式静态滤波器，要么使用基于原始梯度却与优化器无关的动态准则。

sentences.en: We propose OPUS (Optimizer-induced Projected Utility Selection), a dynamic framework that defines utility in the optimizer-induced update space.
sentences.zh: 我们提出OPUS（优化器诱导的投影效用选择），一个在优化器诱导的更新空间中定义效用的动态框架。

sentences.en: OPUS scores candidates by projecting their effective updates, shaped by modern optimizers, onto a target direction derived from a stable, in-distribution proxy.
sentences.zh: OPUS通过将由现代优化器塑造的有效更新投影到一个从稳定、分布内代理导出的目标方向上，对候选进行打分。

sentences.en: To ensure scalability, we employ Ghost technique with CountSketch for computational efficiency, and Boltzmann sampling for data diversity, incurring only 4.7% additional compute overhead.
sentences.zh: 为确保可扩展性，我们采用带CountSketch的Ghost技术以提高计算效率，并采用Boltzmann采样以增加数据多样性，仅产生4.7%的额外计算开销。

sentences.en: OPUS achieves remarkable results across diverse corpora, quality tiers, optimizers, and model scales.
sentences.zh: OPUS在多样化的语料库、质量层级、优化器和模型规模上取得了显著成果。

sentences.en: In pre-training of GPT-2 Large/XL on FineWeb and FineWeb-Edu with 30B tokens, OPUS outperforms industrial-level baselines and even full 200B-token training.
sentences.zh: 在用FineWeb和FineWeb-Edu上的30B词元预训练GPT-2 Large/XL时，OPUS超越了工业级基线，甚至超越了完整的200B词元训练。

sentences.en: Moreover, when combined with industrial-level static filters, OPUS further improves pre-training efficiency, even with lower-quality data.
sentences.zh: 此外，当与工业级静态滤波器相结合时，OPUS进一步提升了预训练效率，即使在数据质量较低的情况下也是如此。

sentences.en: Furthermore, in continued pre-training of Qwen3-8B-Base on SciencePedia, OPUS achieves superior performance using only 0.5B tokens compared to full training with 3B tokens, demonstrating significant data efficiency gains in specialized domains.
sentences.zh: 更进一步，在SciencePedia上对Qwen3-8B-Base的持续预训练中，OPUS仅用0.5B词元就取得了优于用3B词元完整训练的性能，展示了在专业领域的显著数据效率提升。

title_en: ORBIT: A Prognostic World Model for Ocular Reasoning Based on Imagined Trajectories
title_zh: ORBIT：基于想象轨迹的眼科推理预后世界模型

sentences.en: The longitudinal management of blinding fundus diseases constitutes a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) necessitating a critical precision-risk trade-off between intervention and over-treatment, as true pathology is often obscured in static observations.
sentences.zh: 致盲眼底疾病的纵向管理构成一个部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），要求在干预与过度治疗之间做出关键的精度-风险权衡，因为真实病理往往在静态观测中被掩盖。

sentences.en: However, existing paradigms fail to address this complexity.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有范式未能解决这一复杂性。

sentences.en: Traditional vision models remain uninterpretable and memoryless, and while Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel in semantic understanding, they rely on unsafe open-loop text reasoning lacking the anatomical grounding essential for clinical safety.
sentences.zh: 传统视觉模型不可解释且无记忆，而视觉语言模型（VLMs）擅长语义理解，却依赖不安全的开环文本推理，缺乏临床安全所必需的解剖学基础。

sentences.en: Furthermore, robust learning is hindered by the scarcity of process supervision in sparse clinical records.
sentences.zh: 此外，稀疏临床记录中过程监督的稀缺也阻碍了稳健学习。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce the Logic-Constrained Abductive Data Engine.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入逻辑约束溯因数据引擎。

sentences.en: Operating on a ``Propose-and-Verify'' paradigm, it validates MLLM-proposed biomarkers against clinical and temporal logic to reconstruct dense pathological states from sparse outcomes.
sentences.zh: 它运行在“提出并验证”的范式上，将MLLM提出的生物标志物对照临床与时间逻辑进行验证，从而从稀疏结果重建稠密的病理状态。

sentences.en: Building on this foundation, we propose ORBIT, the first ophthalmic Prognostic World Model.
sentences.zh: 在这一基础上，我们提出ORBIT，首个眼科预后世界模型。

sentences.en: Uniquely, ORBIT employs counterfactual visual foresight to imagine anatomical futures under different treatments, anchoring decisions in Closed-Loop Anatomical Verification rather than linguistic probabilities.
sentences.zh: 独特之处在于，ORBIT采用反事实视觉预知来想象不同治疗下的解剖学未来，将决策锚定在闭环解剖学验证而非语言学概率上。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that ORBIT effectively captures disease evolution and establishes a new paradigm for human-in-the-loop longitudinal decision support and anatomically grounded treatment planning.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，ORBIT有效捕捉疾病演变，并为人在环路的纵向决策支持和基于解剖学的治疗规划确立了新范式。

title_en: Orchestrating Spatial Semantics via a Zone-Graph Paradigm for Intricate Indoor Scene Generation
title_zh: 用区域图范式编排空间语义实现复杂室内场景生成

sentences.en: Autonomous 3D indoor scene synthesis breaks down in non-convex rooms with tightly coupled spatial constraints.
sentences.zh: 自主3D室内场景合成在具有紧密耦合空间约束的非凸房间中会失效。

sentences.en: Data-driven generators lack topological priors for long-horizon planning, while iterative agents fragment semantics and become geometrically brittle.
sentences.zh: 数据驱动生成器缺乏用于长程规划的拓扑先验，而迭代式智能体则割裂语义并在几何上变得脆弱。

sentences.en: We present \textbf{ZoneMaestro}, a unified framework that shifts the paradigm from object-centric synthesis to Zone-Graph Orchestration.
sentences.zh: 我们提出\textbf{ZoneMaestro}，一个将范式从以对象为中心合成转向区域图编排的统一框架。

sentences.en: By internalizing a novel zone-based logic, ZoneMaestro translates high-level semantic intent into functional zones and topological constraints, enabling robust adaptation to diverse architectural forms.
sentences.zh: 通过内化一种新颖的基于区域的逻辑，ZoneMaestro将高层语义意图转化为功能区域和拓扑约束，从而能稳健地适应多样的建筑形式。

sentences.en: To support this, we construct \textit{Zone-Scene-10K}, a large-scale dataset enriched with explicit Zone-Graph annotations.
sentences.zh: 为支持这一目标，我们构建了\textit{Zone-Scene-10K}，一个富含有显式区域图标注的大规模数据集。

sentences.en: We further introduce an \textit{Alternating Alignment Strategy} that cycles between reasoning internalization and Zone-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (\textit{Z-GRPO}), effectively reconciling the tension between semantic richness and geometric validity without relying on external physics engines.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步引入一种\textit{交替对齐策略}，在推理内化与区域感知分组相对策略优化（\textit{Z-GRPO}）之间循环，有效调和语义丰富性与几何有效性之间的张力，而无需依赖外部物理引擎。

sentences.en: To rigorously evaluate spatial intelligence beyond convex primitives, we formally define the task of \textbf{Intricate Spatial Orchestration} and release SCALE, a stress-test benchmark for irregular indoor scenarios with complex, dense spatial relations.
sentences.zh: 为在凸基元之外严格评估空间智能，我们正式定义\textbf{复杂空间编排}任务，并发布SCALE，一个针对具有复杂密集空间关系的非规则室内场景的压力测试基准。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that ZoneMaestro resolves the density-safety dichotomy, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in both structural coherence and intent adherence.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，ZoneMaestro化解了密度-安全性二分困境，在结构连贯性和意图遵从度两方面都显著超越最先进基线。

title_en: OrchJail: Jailbreaking Tool-Calling Text-to-Image Agents by Orchestration-Guided Fuzzing
title_zh: OrchJail：通过编排引导的模糊测试越狱调用工具的文生图智能体

sentences.en: Tool-calling text-to-image (T2I) agents can plan and execute multi-step tool chains to accomplish complex generation and editing queries.
sentences.zh: 调用工具的文本到图像（T2I）智能体能规划并执行多步工具链，以完成复杂的生成和编辑查询。

sentences.en: However, this capability introduces a new safety attack surface: harmful outputs may arise from tool orchestration, where individually benign steps combine into unsafe results, making prompt-only jailbreak techniques insufficient.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一能力引入了新的安全攻击面：有害输出可能源于工具编排，其中单个良性的步骤组合成不安全的结果，使仅靠提示词的越狱技术不再充分。

sentences.en: We present OrchJail, an orchestration-guided fuzzing framework for jailbreaking tool-calling T2I agents.
sentences.zh: 我们提出OrchJail，一个用于越狱调用工具的T2I智能体的编排引导模糊测试框架。

sentences.en: Its core idea is to exploit high‑risk tool‑orchestration patterns: by learning from successful jailbreak tool-calling traces and their causal relationships to prompt wording, OrchJail directly guides the fuzzing search toward prompts that are more likely to trigger unsafe multi‑step tool behaviors, rather than relying on surface‑level textual perturbations.
sentences.zh: 其核心思想是利用高风险工具编排模式：通过学习成功的越狱工具调用轨迹及其与提示词措辞的因果关系，OrchJail直接引导模糊测试搜索朝向更可能触发不安全多步工具行为的提示词，而非依赖表面层面的文本扰动。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that OrchJail improves jailbreak effectiveness and efficiency across representative tool-calling T2I agents,  achieving higher attack success rates, better image fidelity, and lower query costs, while remaining robust against common jailbreak defenses.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，OrchJail在代表性的调用工具的T2I智能体上提升了越狱有效性与效率，取得了更高的攻击成功率、更好的图像保真度和更低的查询成本，同时对其常见越狱防御保持稳健。

sentences.en: Our work highlights tool orchestration as a critical, previously unexplored attack surface and provides a novel framework for uncovering safety risks in T2I agents.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作凸显了工具编排作为一个关键但先前未探索的攻击面，并为揭示T2I智能体中的安全风险提供了一个新颖框架。

title_en: Order Matters in Retrosynthesis: Structure-aware Generation via Reaction-Center-Guided Discrete Flow Matching
title_zh: 逆合成中的顺序很重要：通过反应中心引导的离散流匹配进行结构感知生成

sentences.en: Template-free retrosynthesis methods treat the task as black-box sequence generation, limiting learning efficiency, while semi-template approaches rely on rigid reaction libraries that constrain generalization.
sentences.zh: 无模板逆合成方法将该任务视为黑盒序列生成，限制了学习效率，而半模板方法依赖约束泛化的刚性反应库。

sentences.en: We address this gap with a key insight: atom ordering in neural representations matters.
sentences.zh: 我们用一个关键洞见填补这一差距：神经表示中的原子排序很重要。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we propose a structure-aware template-free framework that encodes the two-stage nature of chemical reactions as a positional inductive bias.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出一个结构感知的无模板框架，将化学反应的两阶段特性编码为一个位置归纳偏置。

sentences.en: By placing reaction center atoms at the sequence head, our method transforms implicit chemical knowledge into explicit positional patterns that the model can readily capture.
sentences.zh: 通过将反应中心原子置于序列头部，我们的方法把隐式化学知识转化为模型易于捕捉的显式位置模式。

sentences.en: The proposed RetroDiT backbone, a graph transformer with rotary position embeddings, exploits this ordering to prioritize chemically critical regions.
sentences.zh: 所提出的RetroDiT骨干网络是一种带旋转位置嵌入的图变换器，利用这一排序优先关注化学上关键的区域。

sentences.en: Combined with discrete flow matching, our approach decouples training from sampling and enables generation in 20--50 steps versus 500 for prior diffusion methods.
sentences.zh: 与离散流匹配相结合，我们的方法将训练与采样解耦，并能以20--50步生成，而先前扩散方法需要500步。

sentences.en: Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both USPTO-50k (61.2\% top-1) and the large-scale USPTO-Full (51.3\% top-1) with predicted reaction centers.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法在USPTO-50k（61.2\% top-1）和大型USPTO-Full（51.3\% top-1）上用预测的反应中心都达到了最先进性能。

sentences.en: With oracle centers, performance reaches 71.1\% and 63.4\% respectively, surpassing foundation models trained on 10 billion reactions while using orders of magnitude less data.
sentences.zh: 用先知中心时，性能分别达到71.1\%和63.4\%，超越在100亿反应上训练的基础模型，而所用数据量少了数个数量级。

sentences.en: Ablation studies further reveal that structural priors outperform brute-force scaling: a 280K-parameter model with proper ordering matches a 65M-parameter model without it.
sentences.zh: 消融研究进一步揭示，结构先验优于暴力扩展：具有恰当排序的28万参数模型匹配没有它的6500万参数模型。

title_en: Order Matters: Unveiling the Hidden Impact of Macro Placement Sequences via Proxy-Guided LLM Evolution
title_zh: 顺序很重要：通过代理引导的LLM演化揭示宏单元布局序列的隐蔽影响

sentences.en: Macro placement is a fundamental step in modern VLSI physical design, determining the solution quality of high-dimensional combinatorial optimization problems.
sentences.zh: 宏单元布局是现代VLSI物理设计中的一个基本步骤，决定了高维组合优化问题的求解质量。

sentences.en: Despite recent advancements in machine learning for spatial coordinate determination, the temporal dimension of placement sequencing remains largely governed by static heuristics.
sentences.zh: 尽管机器学习在空间坐标确定方面取得了最新进展，但布局排序的时间维度在很大程度上仍由静态启发式支配。

sentences.en: In this work, we demonstrate that the placement sequence is not merely a preprocessing step but a decisive factor in optimization, where suboptimal early decisions trigger irreversible domino effects that constrain the solution space.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们证明布局序列不仅是预处理步骤，更是优化中的决定性因素，其中次优的早期决策会触发不可逆的多米诺效应，从而约束解空间。

sentences.en: To harness this unexplored dimension, we propose \textbf{OrderPlace}, a novel framework that automates the discovery of macro placement strategies via proxy-guided Large Language Model (LLM) evolution.
sentences.zh: 为利用这一未被探索的维度，我们提出\textbf{OrderPlace}，一个通过代理引导的大语言模型（LLM）演化自动发现宏单元布局策略的新颖框架。

sentences.en: Unlike existing methods that rely on manual rules like area or connectivity, OrderPlace leverages LLMs to evolve generalizable, code-level ordering strategies—ranging from static metrics to dynamic, physics-inspired mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 与依赖面积或连通性等手动规则的现有方法不同，OrderPlace利用LLM演化出可泛化的、代码级的排序策略——从静态度量到动态的、受物理启发的机制。

sentences.en: To mitigate the prohibitive cost of evaluating sequences, we introduce a lightweight proxy evaluation mechanism that efficiently filters candidates using a deterministic greedy probe.
sentences.zh: 为缓解评估序列的高昂成本，我们引入一种轻量级代理评估机制，用确定性贪婪探针高效筛选候选。

sentences.en: Experimental results on the standard ISPD 2005 benchmarks demonstrate that OrderPlace discovers novel ordering strategies.
sentences.zh: 在标准ISPD 2005基准上的实验结果表明，OrderPlace发现了新颖的排序策略。

sentences.en: Compared with WireMask-EA and the state-of-the-art method EGPlace, OrderPlace reduces wirelength by 34.04% and 14.08%, respectively.
sentences.zh: 与WireMask-EA和最新方法EGPlace相比，OrderPlace分别将线长减少了34.04%和14.08%。

title_en: Order within Chaos: Capturing Intrinsic Energy Anomalies for AI-Manipulated Image Forgery Localization
title_zh: 混沌中的秩序：为AI操控图像伪造定位捕捉内在能量异常

sentences.en: Recent advancements in generative AI have led to image editing models capable of producing realistic forgeries that evade traditional image forgery localization methods, as these approaches depend on physical noise absent in synthetic data.
sentences.zh: 生成式AI的最新进展带来了能产生逼真伪造的图像编辑模型，这些伪造能躲避传统图像伪造定位方法，因为这类方法依赖合成数据中不存在的物理噪声。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we theoretically demonstrate that the diffusion process inherently suppresses local high-frequency variance, creating a statistical energy gap that is distinguishable from the natural entropy of optical imaging.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们从理论上证明，扩散过程内在抑制局部高频方差，造成一个与光学成像自然熵可区分的统计能量间隙。

sentences.en: Guided by this insight, we propose FLAME, a unified framework that utilizes a LAD map to capture these intrinsic anomalies, coupled with a parameter-efficient adapter for SAM to achieve precise, pixel-level forgery localization.
sentences.zh: 在这一洞见的指引下，我们提出FLAME，一个利用LAD图捕捉这些内在异常的统一框架，并结合针对SAM的参数高效适配器，实现精确的像素级伪造定位。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to bridge the lag between forensic benchmarks and evolving generative models, we introduce EditStream, an automated pipeline for continuous, instruction-based training data synthesis.
sentences.zh: 此外，为弥合取证基准与不断演变的生成模型之间的滞后，我们引入EditStream，一个用于持续、基于指令的训练数据合成的自动化流水线。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that FLAME establishes a new state-of-the-art, significantly outperforming previous methods on AI-generated forgery datasets while effectively generalizing to unseen generative architectures.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，FLAME确立了新的最先进水平，在AI生成的伪造数据集上显著超越先前方法，同时有效泛化到未见过的生成架构。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/phoenixnir/FLAME.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码见 https://github.com/phoenixnir/FLAME。

title_en: Origo: Interpretable Multi-physics PDE Foundation Model through Neural Operator Splitting
title_zh: Origo：通过神经算子拆分实现可解释的多物理场PDE基础模型

sentences.en: Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) play a fundamental role in scientific computing, and recent efforts have sought to extend the success of foundation models to PDE solving.
sentences.zh: 偏微分方程组（PDEs）在科学计算中起着基础性作用，近期的努力已试图将基础模型的成功扩展到PDE求解。

sentences.en: However, multi-physics PDE pre-training faces the unique challenge of disentangling dynamic heterogeneity to learn universal, elementary patterns that generalize to new PDEs.
sentences.zh: 然而，多物理场PDE预训练面临解耦动态异质性的独特挑战，以学习能泛化到新PDE的通用、基本模式。

sentences.en: Additionally, cross-physics transfer lacks a theoretical framework for interpretability—specifically, understanding which pre-trained operator knowledge is effectively transferred to target PDEs.
sentences.zh: 此外，跨物理场迁移缺乏用于可解释性的理论框架——具体而言，就是理解哪些预训练算子知识被有效迁移到目标PDE。

sentences.en: To bridge these gaps, we introduce the theory of neural operator splitting, which decomposes PDE evolution into a modulated global spectral operator and sparse local constitutive mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这些差距，我们引入神经算子拆分理论，它将PDE演化分解为一个调制的全局谱算子和稀疏的局部本构机制。

sentences.en: A key innovation is Origo, which provides a neural operator bank that enables the identification of operator-level generalization patterns.
sentences.zh: 一个关键创新是Origo，它提供了一个神经算子库，使算子级泛化模式的识别成为可能。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization and mechanism-level interpretability on unseen PDEs.
sentences.zh: 大量实验在未见过的PDE上展示了强大的零样本泛化和机制级可解释性。

title_en: ORLoopBench: Solver-in-the-Loop Benchmarks for Self-Correction and Behavioral Rationality in Operations Research
title_zh: ORLoopBench：运筹学中用于自纠正与行为理性的求解器在环基准

sentences.en: Operations Research practitioners debug infeasible models through an iterative process: inspecting Irreducible Infeasible Subsystems (\textbf{IIS}), identifying constraint conflicts, and repairing formulations until feasibility is restored.
sentences.zh: 运筹学实踩者通过一个迭代过程调试不可行模型：检查不可约不可行子系统（\textbf{IIS}），识别约束冲突，并修复建模，直到恢复可行性。

sentences.en: Existing LLM benchmarks mostly treat OR as one-shot translation from problem descriptions to solver code, omitting this diagnostic loop.
sentences.zh: 现有LLM基准大多将运筹学视为从问题描述到求解器代码的一次性翻译，忽视了这一诊断循环。

sentences.en: We formalize infeasible-model repair as a solver-in-the-loop Markov Decision Process in which each action triggers solver re-execution and \textbf{IIS} recomputation, yielding deterministic, verifiable feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们将不可行模型修复形式化为一个求解器在环的马尔可夫决策过程，其中每个动作都触发求解器重新执行和\textbf{IIS}重新计算，从而产生确定性、可验证的反馈。

sentences.en: We introduce \textbf{ORLoopBench}, a benchmark suite with two components: \textbf{ORDebug} releases 5,362 LP/MILP repair instances, while \textbf{ORBias} evaluates closed-form operational decision rationality across inventory settings.
sentences.zh: 我们引入\textbf{ORLoopBench}基准套件，包含两个组成部分：\textbf{ORDebug}发布5362个LP/MILP修复实例，而\textbf{ORBias}评估跨库存设定的闭式操作决策理性。

sentences.en: Solver-verified RLVR training enables an 8B model to surpass frontier APIs on LP repair (95.3\% vs 92.4\% RR@5), improves diagnostic behavior, and transfers to MILP repair.
sentences.zh: 求解器验证的RLVR训练使一个8B模型在LP修复上超越了前沿API（95.3\%对比92.4\% RR@5），改善了诊断行为，并迁移到MILP修复。

sentences.en: The same evaluation exposes semantic drift in whole-model code regeneration: feasible regenerated MILPs can solve the wrong problem.
sentences.zh: 同样的评估暴露了整模型代码再生成中的语义漂移：可行的再生MILP可能求解错误的问题。

sentences.en: Process-level evaluation with solver oracles enables targeted training for reliable OR self-correction.
sentences.zh: 用求解器判别器的过程级评估，可实现针对可靠运筹学自纠正的定向训练。

title_en: Orthogonal Concept Erasure for Diffusion Models
title_zh: 扩散模型的正交概念擦除

sentences.en: Concept erasure has emerged as a promising approach to mitigate undesired or unsafe content in diffusion models, yet existing methods still face significant limitations.
sentences.zh: 概念擦除已成为缓解扩散模型中不良或不安全内容的一种具有前景的方法，但现有方法仍面临显著限制。

sentences.en: While training-based methods are effective, their high computational cost limits scalability.
sentences.zh: 基于训练的方法虽然有效，但其高昂的计算成本限制了可扩展性。

sentences.en: Editing-based methods are more efficient and deployment-friendly, yet they struggle to simultaneously achieve precise concept erasure and preserve overall generative capacity.
sentences.zh: 基于编辑的方法更高效且便于部署，但难以同时实现精确的概念擦除和保持整体生成能力。

sentences.en: We identify this core limitation of the editing-based methods as reliance on additive parameter updates.
sentences.zh: 我们将基于编辑的方法的这一核心局限归结为对加法参数更新的依赖。

sentences.en: Our empirical analysis reveals that concept semantics primarily depend on *neuron direction* rather than *neuron magnitude*, while overall generative capacity relies on the *angular geometry* of neurons.
sentences.zh: 我们的实证分析揭示，概念语义主要依赖*神经元方向*而非*神经元幅度*，而整体生成能力依赖于神经元的*角度几何*。

sentences.en: As additive updates inherently entangle direction, magnitude, and angular geometry, they inevitably introduce unintended interference between concept erasure and overall generation performance.
sentences.zh: 由于加法更新内在地纠缠方向、幅度和角度几何，它们不可避免地会在概念擦除与整体生成性能之间引入意外的干扰。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose **Orthogonal Concept Erasure (OCE)**, which reformulates editing-based erasure as multiplicative parameter updates from a geometric perspective.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一点，我们提出**正交概念擦除（OCE）**，它从几何视角将基于编辑的擦除重新表述为乘法参数更新。

sentences.en: Specifically, OCE applies layer-wise orthogonal transformations derived from a closed-form solution to the parameters, enabling precise concept erasure while preserving the neuron magnitude and angular geometry.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，OCE对参数应用从闭式解导出的逐层正交变换，从而在保持神经元幅度和角度几何的同时实现精确的概念擦除。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to address conflicting constraints in multi-concept erasure, OCE introduces a subspace-level objective with structured subspace manipulation, yielding a more effective and scalable erasure.
sentences.zh: 此外，为处理多概念擦除中的冲突约束，OCE引入一个带结构化子空间操作的子空间级目标，产生更有效且可扩展的擦除。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on single- and multi-concept erasure demonstrate that OCE outperforms existing methods in concept erasure and non-target preservation, erasing up to 100 concepts in 4.3 s.
sentences.zh: 在单概念和多概念擦除上的大量实验表明，OCE在概念擦除和非目标保持方面优于现有方法，能在4.3秒内擦除多达100个概念。

title_en: Orthogonal Hierarchical Decomposition for Structure-Aware Table Understanding with Large Language Models
title_zh: 面向大语言模型结构感知表格理解的正交层次分解

sentences.en: Complex tables with multi-level headers, merged cells and heterogeneous layouts pose persistent challenges for large language models (LLMs) in both understanding and reasoning.
sentences.zh: 带有多级表头、合并单元格和异质布局的复杂表格，在大语言模型（LLMs）的理解与推理两方面都构成持续挑战。

sentences.en: Existing approaches typically rely on table linearization or normalized grid modeling.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常依赖表格线性化或规范化网格建模。

sentences.en: However, these representations struggle to explicitly capture hierarchical structures and cross-dimensional dependencies, which can lead to misalignment between structural semantics and textual representations for non-standard tables.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些表示难以显式捕捉层次结构和跨维度依赖，这可能导致非标准表格的结构语义与文本表示之间的错配。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose an Orthogonal Hierarchical Decomposition (OHD) framework that constructs structure-preserving input representations of complex tables for LLMs.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出一个正交层次分解（OHD）框架，为LLMs构建复杂表格的保结构输入表示。

sentences.en: OHD introduces an Orthogonal Tree Induction (OTI) method based on spatial--semantic co-constraints, which decomposes irregular tables into a column tree and a row tree to capture vertical and horizontal hierarchical dependencies, respectively.
sentences.zh: OHD引入一种基于空间--语义联合约束的正交树归纳（OTI）方法，将非规则表格分解为列树和行树，分别捕捉垂直与水平的层次依赖。

sentences.en: Building on this representation, we design a dual-pathway association protocol to symmetrically reconstruct the semantic lineage of each cell, and incorporate an LLM as a semantic arbitrator to align multi-level semantic information.
sentences.zh: 在该表示的基础上，我们设计一个双通路关联协议，对称地重建每个单元格的语义谱系，并纳入一个LLM作为语义仲裁者以对齐多层语义信息。

sentences.en: We evaluate OHD framework on two complex table question answering benchmarks, AITQA and HiTab. Experimental results show that OHD consistently outperforms existing representation paradigms across multiple evaluation metrics.
sentences.zh: 我们在两个复杂表格问答基准AITQA和HiTab上评估OHD框架。实验结果显示，OHD在多个评估指标上一致优于现有表示范式。

title_en: Orthogonal Model Merging
title_zh: 正交模型合并

sentences.en: Merging finetuned Large Language Models (LLMs) has become increasingly important for integrating diverse capabilities into a single unified model.
sentences.zh: 合并非微调的大语言模型（LLMs）对于将多样能力整合进一个统一模型变得越来越重要。

sentences.en: However, prevailing model merging methods rely on linear arithmetic in Euclidean space, which often destroys the intrinsic geometric properties of pretrained weights, such as hyperspherical energy.
sentences.zh: 然而，流行的模型合并方法依赖欧氏空间中的线性算术，这常常破坏预训练权重的内在几何性质，例如超球面能量。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Orthogonal Model Merging (OrthoMerge), a method that performs merging operations on the Riemannian manifold formed by the orthogonal group to preserve the geometric structure of the model’s weights.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一点，我们提出正交模型合并（OrthoMerge），一种在由正交群形成的黎曼流形上执行合并操作、以保持模型权重的几何结构的方法。

sentences.en: By mapping task-specific orthogonal matrices learned by Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT) to the Lie algebra, OrthoMerge enables a principled yet efficient integration that takes into account both the direction and intensity of adaptations.
sentences.zh: 通过将由正交微调（OFT）学得的任务特定正交矩阵映射到李代数，OrthoMerge实现了有原则且高效的整合，同时考虑适应的方向与强度。

sentences.en: In addition to directly leveraging orthogonal matrices obtained by OFT, we further extend this approach to general models finetuned with non-OFT methods (e.g., low-rank finetuning, full finetuning) via an Orthogonal-Residual Decoupling strategy.
sentences.zh: 除直接利用OFT获得的正交矩阵外，我们还通过正交-残差解耦策略，将这一方法扩展到用非OFT方法（例如低秩微调、全参数微调）微调的通用模型。

sentences.en: This technique extracts the orthogonal components of expert models by solving the orthogonal Procrustes problem, which are then merged on the manifold of the orthogonal group, while the remaining linear residuals are processed through standard additive merging.
sentences.zh: 这一技术通过求解正交Procrustes问题提取专家模型的正交分量，这些分量随后在正交群的流形上合并，而剩余的线性残差则通过标准加法合并处理。

sentences.en: Extensive empirical results demonstrate the effectiveness of OrthoMerge in mitigating catastrophic forgetting and maintaining model performance across diverse tasks.
sentences.zh: 大量实证结果表明，OrthoMerge在缓解灾难性遗忘和跨多样任务保持模型性能方面具有有效性。

title_en: OSAQ: Outlier Self-Absorption for Accurate Low-bit LLM Quantization
title_zh: OSAQ：用于精确低位LLM量化的异常值自吸收

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in understanding and generation tasks.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在理解与生成任务中展现了卓越的能力。

sentences.en: However, their massive parameter scale leads to significant resource consumption and latency during inference.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们巨大的参数规模导致推理期间显著的资源消耗和延迟。

sentences.en: Post-training weight-only quantization offers a promising solution by reducing model size and accelerating token generation through alleviating the memory-bound issue.
sentences.zh: 训练后仅权重量化通过缩小模型尺寸并缓解内存受限问题来加速词元生成，提供了一种有前景的方案。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, there are inherent systematic outliers in weights, and although some efforts have attempted to address them, such as scaling and rotation, the performance of low-bit quantization remains far from satisfactory.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，权重中存在固有的系统性异常值，且尽管一些工作已尝试解决它们（例如缩放和旋转），低位量化的性能仍远不能令人满意。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Outlier Self-Absorption Quantization (OSAQ), which performs second-order low-rank derived additive weight suppression for low-bit weight-only LLM quantization.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出异常值自吸收量化（OSAQ），它为低位仅权重大语言模型量化执行二阶低秩导出的加法性权重抑制。

sentences.en: Specifically, we observe that Hessian exhibits low-rank consistency across different inputs, with certain directions persistently lacking strength.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们观察到Hessian在不同输入上表现出低秩一致性，某些方向持续缺乏强度。

sentences.en: Leveraging this property, we construct an additive weight transformation based on the Hessian’s null space, thereby suppressing weight outliers without affecting the task loss.
sentences.zh: 利用这一性质，我们基于Hessian的零空间构建一个加法性权重变换，从而在不影响任务损失的情况下抑制权重异常值。

sentences.en: This additive transformation can be absorbed into the weights offline, requiring no inter-layer transformations and introducing no inference overhead.
sentences.zh: 这一加法变换可以离线吸收到权重中，无需层间变换，也不引入推理开销。

sentences.en: Moreover, the construction is efficiently achieved by a closed-form solution, without resource-intensive training or iterative procedures.
sentences.zh: 此外，该构造通过闭式解高效实现，无需资源密集的训练或迭代过程。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across models of varying scales and tasks are conducted, and the results show that OSAQ effectively suppresses outliers and improves low-bit quantization performance.
sentences.zh: 我们跨不同规模模型和任务进行了大量实验，结果表明OSAQ有效抑制异常值并提升了低位量化性能。

title_en: OSCS: Online Selection with Provable FAR Control for LLM Safety
title_zh: OSCS：带可证明FAR控制的LLM安全在线选择

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to malicious inputs, posing serious risks in high-stakes applications.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）易受恶意输入攻击，在高风险应用中构成严重风险。

sentences.en: Although existing detection-based defenses achieve strong empirical performance, they generally lack explicit control over the false acceptance rate (FAR), a critical safety requirement in sensitive deployment scenarios.
sentences.zh: 尽管现有的基于检测的防御取得了强实证性能，但它们普遍缺乏对误接受率（FAR）的显式控制，而这是敏感部署场景中的一个关键安全要求。

sentences.en: This challenge is further complicated by two practical constraints: the lack of malicious calibration samples and the streaming nature of real-world inputs.
sentences.zh: 这一挑战因两个实际约束而更加复杂：缺乏恶意校准样本，以及真实世界输入的流式特性。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose \textit{OSCS}, a novel framework for online FAR control without requiring malicious calibration data.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出\textit{OSCS}，一个无需恶意校准数据即可进行在线FAR控制的新颖框架。

sentences.en: OSCS leverages detection scores produced by existing defenses and employs recursive density estimation to estimate benign probability from the test stream.
sentences.zh: OSCS利用现有防御产生的检测分数，并采用递归密度估计从测试流中估计良性概率。

sentences.en: Based on these estimates, OSCS performs real-time accept/reject decisions while provably satisfying a user-specified FAR target.
sentences.zh: 基于这些估计，OSCS执行实时的接受/拒绝决策，同时可证明地满足用户指定的FAR目标。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we show that OSCS controls the FAR up to a vanishing excess term under mild assumptions.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们表明在温和假设下OSCS将FAR控制在可忽略的过剩项之内。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on backdoor and jailbreak attack tasks further demonstrate the effectiveness of OSCS, showing that it consistently achieves robust FAR control across diverse attack settings while outperforming existing baselines.
sentences.zh: 在后门与越狱攻击任务上的大量实验进一步展示了OSCS的有效性，表明它在多样的攻击设定中始终实现稳健的FAR控制，同时超越现有基线。

title_en: OServe: Accelerating LLM Serving via Spatial-Temporal Workload Orchestration
title_zh: OServe：通过时空工作负载编排加速LLM服务

sentences.en: Serving Large Language Models (LLMs) can benefit immensely from parallelizing both the model and input requests across multiple devices, but incoming workloads exhibit substantial spatial and temporal heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 服务大语言模型（LLMs）可以极大受益于在多个设备上并行化模型与输入请求，但到来的工作负载表现出显著的空间与时间异质性。

sentences.en: Spatially, workloads comprise heterogeneous requests with varying compute and memory demands.
sentences.zh: 在空间上，工作负载由计算和内存需求各异的异质请求组成。

sentences.en: Temporally, workload composition varies over time.
sentences.zh: 在时间上，工作负载组成随时间变化。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, existing systems typically assume spatially uniform and temporally stable workloads, employing a homogeneous, static model deployment.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有系统通常假设空间均匀且时间稳定的工作负载，采用同质、静态的模型部署。

sentences.en: This mismatch between the assumption and real-world spatial-temporal heterogeneity results in suboptimal performance.
sentences.zh: 这一假设与真实世界时空异质性之间的不匹配导致次优性能。

sentences.en: We present OServe, an LLM serving system with heterogeneous and flexible model deployment that addresses both spatial and temporal heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 我们提出OServe，一个采用异质且灵活模型部署的LLM服务系统，同时处理空间和时间异质性。

sentences.en: First, OServe introduces a novel workload-aware scheduling algorithm that optimizes heterogeneous model deployments according to real-time workload characteristics.
sentences.zh: 首先，OServe引入一种新颖的工作负载感知调度算法，根据实时工作负载特征优化异质模型部署。

sentences.en: Second, OServe proposes an efficient workload-adaptive switching method that migrates model deployments in response to predicted workload changes.
sentences.zh: 其次，OServe提出一种高效的工作负载自适应切换方法，响应预测到的工作负载变化而迁移模型部署。

sentences.en: Experiments on real-world traces show that OServe improves performance by up to 2$\times$ (average: 1.5$\times$) compared to state-of-the-art serving systems.
sentences.zh: 在真实世界轨迹上的实验表明，与最先进的服务系统相比，OServe将性能提升多达2$\times$（平均1.5$\times$）。

title_en: OSF: On Pre-training and Scaling of Sleep Foundation Models
title_zh: OSF：论睡眠基础模型的预训练与扩展

sentences.en: Polysomnography (PSG) provides the gold standard for sleep assessment but suffers from substantial heterogeneity across recording devices and cohorts.
sentences.zh: 多导睡眠图（PSG）提供睡眠评估的金标准，但遭受跨记录设备与队列的显著异质性。

sentences.en: There have been growing efforts to build general-purpose foundation models (FMs) for sleep physiology, but lack an in-depth understanding of the pre-training process and scaling patterns that lead to more generalizable sleep FMs.
sentences.zh: 为睡眠生理学构建通用基础模型（FMs）的努力日益增多，但缺乏对能使睡眠FM更具泛化性的预训练过程和扩展模式的深入理解。

sentences.en: To fill this gap, we curate a massive corpus of 166,500 hours of sleep recordings from nine public sources and establish SleepBench, a comprehensive, fully open-source benchmark.
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们整理了来自九个公开来源的166500小时睡眠记录的海量语料，并建立了SleepBench，一个全面、完全开源的基础基准。

sentences.en: Leveraging SleepBench, we systematically evaluate four families of self-supervised pre-training objectives and uncover three critical findings: (1) existing FMs fail to generalize to missing channels at inference; (2) channel-invariant feature learning is essential for pre-training; and (3) scaling sample size, model capacity, and multi-source data mixture consistently improves downstream performance.
sentences.zh: 利用SleepBench，我们系统评估了四类自监督预训练目标，并揭示了三个关键发现：（1）现有FM在推理时无法泛化到缺失通道；（2）通道不变特征学习对预训练至关重要；（3）扩展样本量、模型容量和多来源数据混合一致地提升下游性能。

sentences.en: With an enhanced pre-training and scaling recipe, we introduce OSF, a family of sleep FMs that achieves state-of-the-art performance across nine datasets on diverse sleep and disease prediction tasks.
sentences.zh: 凭借增强的预训练与扩展配方，我们引入OSF，一个睡眠FM系列，在多样的睡眠与疾病预测任务中于九个数据集上达到了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: Further analysis of OSF also reveals intriguing properties in sample efficiency, hierarchical aggregation, and cross-dataset scaling.
sentences.zh: 对OSF的进一步分析还揭示了样本效率、层次聚合和跨数据集扩展方面的有趣性质。

sentences.en: Codes are available at: https://github.com/yang-ai-lab/OSF-Open-Sleep-FM.
sentences.zh: 代码见：https://github.com/yang-ai-lab/OSF-Open-Sleep-FM。

title_en: OSM+: Billion-Level Open Street Map  Dataset for City-wide Experiments
title_zh: OSM+：面向全市尺实验的十亿级OpenStreetMap数据集

sentences.en: Road network data provides rich information about cities, but processing a large volume of worldwide OpenStreetMap (OSM) data is computationally intensive, and the resulting graphs are often difficult to unify for benchmarking downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 道路网络数据提供关于城市的丰富信息，但处理大规模全球OpenStreetMap（OSM）数据计算密集，且由此产生的图往往难以统一用于下游任务的基准评测。

sentences.en: Existing graph learning benchmarks fail to capture the billion-scale and unique topological properties of real-world road networks, leading to a gap in our understanding of model scalability.
sentences.zh: 现有的图学习基准无法捕捉真实道路网络的十亿级规模和独特拓扑性质，导致我们在模型可扩展性理解上的空白。

sentences.en: To study and close this gap, we process OpenStreetMap data with distributed cloud computing using 5,000 cores and release OSM+, a structured worldwide 1-billion-vertex road network graph dataset designed for high accessibility and usability.
sentences.zh: 为研究并弥合这一空白，我们用分布式云计算在5000个核上处理OpenStreetMap数据，并发布OSM+，一个结构化的、覆盖全球的十亿顶点道路网络图数据集，专为高可访问性和易用性设计。

sentences.en: OSM+ is open source and globally downloadable, and it provides an open-box graph structure together with an easy spatial query interface.
sentences.zh: OSM+是开源的，可全球下载，它提供开箱即用的图结构以及一个便捷的空间查询接口。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the utility of OSM+ through three illustrative use cases: city boundary detection, traffic prediction, and traffic policy control.
sentences.zh: 我们通过三个示例性用例展示OSM+的实用性：城市边界检测、交通预测和交通策略控制。

sentences.en: For traffic prediction, we construct a new 31-city benchmark by processing traffic data and combining it with OSM+, enabling broader spatial coverage and more comprehensive evaluation than previously frequently-used datasets, while scaling from hundreds of road network intersections to thousands.
sentences.zh: 对于交通预测，我们通过处理交通数据并将其与OSM+结合，构建了一个新的31城市基准，实现比以往常用数据集更广的空间覆盖和更全面的评估，同时将规模从数百个道路网络交叉口扩展到数千个。

sentences.en: For traffic policy control, we release a new six-city dataset at a much larger scale, introducing challenges for thousand-scale multi-agent coordination.
sentences.zh: 对于交通策略控制，我们发布了一个规模大得多、覆盖六个城市的新数据集，为千规模多智能体协调引入挑战。

sentences.en: In addition, we provide comprehensive data processing tools that support integrating multimodal spatial-temporal data with OSM+ for geospatial foundation model training, thereby expediting the discovery of compelling scientific insights.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提供全面的数据处理工具，支持将多模态时空数据与OSM+集成用于地理空间基础模型训练，从而加速有说服力的科学洞见的发现。

title_en: OSNIP: Balancing the Privacy-Utility-Efficiency Trilemma in LLM Inference via Obfuscated Semantic Null Space
title_zh: OSNIP：通过混淆语义零空间平衡LLM推理中的隐私-效用-效率三难困境

sentences.en: We propose Obfuscated Semantic Null Space Injection for Privacy (OSNIP), a lightweight client-side encryption framework for privacy-preserving LLM inference.
sentences.zh: 我们提出用于隐私保护LLM推理的混淆语义零空间注入（OSNIP），一个轻量级客户端加密框架。

sentences.en: Generalizing the geometric intuition of linear kernels to the high-dimensional latent space of LLMs, we formally define the ``Obfuscated Semantic Null Space'', a high-dimensional regime that preserves semantic fidelity while enforcing near-orthogonality to the original embedding.
sentences.zh: 将线性核的几何直觉推广到LLM的高维潜在空间，我们正式定义Obfuscated Semantic Null Space，一个在保持语义保真度的同时强制与原始嵌入近正交的高维域。

sentences.en: By injecting perturbations that project the original embedding into this space, OSNIP ensures privacy without any post-processing.
sentences.zh: 通过注入能将原始嵌入投影到这一空间的扰动，OSNIP无需任何后处理即可保证隐私。

sentences.en: Furthermore, OSNIP employs a key-dependent stochastic mapping that generates distinct perturbations under fresh keys.
sentences.zh: 此外，OSNIP采用一个与密钥相关的随机映射，在新密钥下生成不同的扰动。

sentences.en: Evaluations on generative and classification benchmarks show that OSNIP achieves state-of-the-art performance, sharply reducing attack success rates while maintaining strong model utility under strict security constraints.
sentences.zh: 在生成与分类基准上的评估表明，OSNIP实现了最先进的性能，在严格安全约束下大幅降低攻击成功率，同时保持强大的模型效用。

title_en: OTora: A Unified Red Teaming Framework for Reasoning-Level Denial-of-Service in LLM Agents
title_zh: OTora：面向LLM智能体推理级拒绝服务攻击的统一红队框架

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that execute tool-augmented, multi-step tasks, where latency is a critical factor for real-world applications.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被部署为执行工具增强的多步任务的自主智能体，其中延迟是现实应用的一个关键因素。

sentences.en: Yet an overlooked threat is Reasoning-Level Denial-of-Service (R-DoS), in which an attacker preserves task correctness but degrades availability by inflating an agent’s reasoning depth or tool-use budget.
sentences.zh: 然而一个被忽视的威胁是推理级拒绝服务（R-DoS），攻击者在其中保持任务正确性，却通过膨胀智能体的推理深度或工具使用预算来降低可用性。

sentences.en: We introduce OTora, the first unified, two-stage red-teaming framework for instantiating R-DoS attacks.
sentences.zh: 我们引入OTora，首个用于实例化R-DoS攻击的统一两阶段红队框架。

sentences.en: Stage I optimizes an adversarial trigger that induces targeted tool invocations using insertion-aware scoring and dynamic target co-evolution, supporting both black-box and white-box settings.
sentences.zh: 阶段I优化一个对抗触发器，利用插入感知评分和动态目标协同演化诱导目标工具调用，同时支持黑盒和白盒设定。

sentences.en: Stage II generates agent-aware reasoning payloads via an ICL-guided genetic search that amplifies overthinking while maintaining correct task outcomes.
sentences.zh: 阶段II通过一个ICL引导的遗传搜索生成智能体感知的推理载荷，在放大过度思考的同时保持正确的任务结果。

sentences.en: Across WebShop, Email, and OS agents built on multiple backbone models such as LLaMA-70B and GPT-OSS-120B, OTora achieves up to 10× increases in reasoning tokens and order-of-magnitude latency slowdowns, all while preserving near-baseline task accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在构建于LLaMA-70B和GPT-OSS-120B等多个骨干模型之上的WebShop、Email和OS智能体上，OTora实现了推理词元多达10倍的增加和数量级的延迟放缓，同时保持接近基线的任务准确率。

sentences.en: Finally, we discuss mitigation strategies for detecting and constraining abnormal reasoning and latency spikes.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们讨论用于检测和约束异常推理与延迟尖峰的缓解策略。

title_en: Out-of-Distribution Evaluation of Rule-Based and Strategic Reasoning in Chess Transformers
title_zh: 国际象棋Transformer中基于规则与战略推理的分布外评估

sentences.en: Modern decision transformers, trained similarly to LLMs, can achieve strong in-distribution performance in complex sequential domains like chess, but it remains unclear to what extent they reason systematically about rules and strategy.
sentences.zh: 仿照LLM训练的现代决策Transformer能在国际象棋等复杂序列领域中取得强大的分布内性能，但它们能在多大程度上系统地推理规则与战略仍不清楚。

sentences.en: We study the reasoning capabilities of a 270M-parameter chess transformer trained via behavior cloning on standard chess.
sentences.zh: 我们研究一个通过标准国际象棋行为克隆训练的2.7亿参数国际象棋Transformer的推理能力。

sentences.en: To investigate its abilities, we construct out-of-distribution test sets ---including board states and variants never seen during training---designed to reveal failures of systematic generalization.
sentences.zh: 为研究其能力，我们构建了分布外测试集——包括训练中从未见过的棋盘状态与变体——旨在揭示系统泛化的失败。

sentences.en: Our analysis shows that the model exhibits robust rule-based reasoning, consistently generating legal moves in novel configurations, but its strategic reasoning is more limited.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析表明，该模型表现出稳健的基于规则的推理，在新颖棋局中持续生成合法走法，但它的战略推理更为有限。

sentences.en: The model generates high-quality moves on curated OOD puzzles and shows basic strategy adaptation in full games.
sentences.zh: 该模型在精选的OOD谜题上生成高质量走法，并在完整对局中表现出基本的战略适应。

sentences.en: It underperforms symbolic AI algorithms that rely on explicit search, although the performance gap is smaller when playing against human users on Lichess.
sentences.zh: 它逊色于依赖显式搜索的符号AI算法，尽管在Lichess上与人类用户对弈时性能差距更小。

sentences.en: Moreover, the training dynamics reveals distinct phases in how the model learns to respect the fundamental constraints, suggesting an emergent compositional understanding of the game.
sentences.zh: 此外，训练动力学揭示了模型学会尊重基本约束的截然不同阶段，提示对游戏的涌现式组合理解。

title_en: Outcome Rewards Do Not Guarantee Verifiable or Causally Important Reasoning
title_zh: 结果奖励并不能保证可验证或因果重要的推理

sentences.en: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) on chain-of-thought reasoning has become a standard part of language model post-training recipes.
sentences.zh: 在思维链推理上使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为语言模型后训练流水线的一个标准组成部分。

sentences.en: A common assumption is that the reasoning chains trained through RLVR reliably represent how a model gets to its answer.
sentences.zh: 一个常见假设是，通过RLVR训练的推理链可靠地代表了模型到达其答案的方式。

sentences.en: In this paper, we develop two metrics for critically examining this assumption: Causal Importance of Reasoning (CIR), which measures the cumulative effect of reasoning tokens on the final answer, and Sufficiency of Reasoning (SR), which measures whether a verifier can arrive at an unambiguous answer based on the reasoning alone.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们开发两个用于严格检验这一假设的指标：推理的因果重要性（CIR），它衡量推理词元对最终答案的累积效应；以及推理的充分性（SR），它衡量验证器能否仅凭推理就得出无歧义的答案。

sentences.en: Through experiments with the Qwen2.5 model series and ReasoningGym tasks, we find that: (1) While RLVR does improve task accuracy, it does not reliably improve CIR or SR, calling the role of reasoning in model performance into question.
sentences.zh: 通过Qwen2.5模型系列和ReasoningGym任务的实验，我们发现：（1）虽然RLVR确实提升了任务准确率，但它并不能可靠地提升CIR或SR，使推理在模型性能中的作用受到质疑。

sentences.en: (2) A small amount of SFT before RLVR can be a remedy for low CIR and SR.
sentences.zh: （2）RLVR之前少量SFT可以补救低CIR和SR。

sentences.en: (3) CIR and SR can be improved even without SFT by applying auxiliary CIR/SR rewards on top of the outcome-based reward.
sentences.zh: （3）即使没有SFT，通过在基于结果的奖励之上应用辅助的CIR/SR奖励，也可以改进CIR和SR。

sentences.en: This joint reward matches the accuracy of RLVR while also leading to causally important and sufficient reasoning.
sentences.zh: 这一联合奖励匹配了RLVR的准确率，同时也产生了因果重要且充分的推理。

sentences.en: These results show that RLVR does not always lead models to rely on reasoning in the way that is commonly thought, but this issue can be remedied with simple modifications to the post-training procedure.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，RLVR并不总是以人们普遍认为的方式引导模型依赖推理，但这一问题可以通过对后训练过程的简单修改加以补救。

title_en: Outcome-Aware Spectral Feature Learning for Instrumental Variable Regression
title_zh: 面向工具变量回归的结果感知谱特征学习

sentences.en: We address the problem of causal effect estimation in the presence of hidden confounders using nonparametric instrumental variable (IV) regression.
sentences.zh: 我们使用非参数工具变量（IV）回归解决在隐藏混杂时因果效应估计的问题。

sentences.en: An established approach is to use estimators based on learned \emph{spectral features}, that is, features spanning the top singular subspaces of the operator linking treatments to instruments.
sentences.zh: 一种成熟的方法是基于所学的\emph{谱特征}的估计器，即张成连接处理与工具算子的前几个奇异子空间的特征。

sentences.en: While powerful, such features are agnostic to the outcome variable.
sentences.zh: 虽然这类特征功能强大，但它们对结果变量不可知。

sentences.en: Consequently, the method can fail when the true causal function is poorly represented by these dominant singular functions.
sentences.zh: 因此，当真实因果函数不能被这些主导奇异函数充分表示时，该方法可能失效。

sentences.en: To mitigate, we introduce Augmented Spectral Feature Learning, a framework that makes the feature learning process outcome-aware.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，我们引入增强谱特征学习，一个使特征学习过程结局感知的框架。

sentences.en: Our method learns features by minimizing a novel contrastive loss derived from an augmented operator that incorporates information from the outcome.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法通过最小化一个从合并了结果信息的增强算子导出的新颖对比损失来学习特征。

sentences.en: By learning these task-specific features, our approach remains effective even under spectral misalignment.
sentences.zh: 通过学习这些任务特定的特征，即使在谱错位下我们的方法也保持有效。

sentences.en: We provide a theoretical analysis of this framework and validate our approach on challenging benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们为这一框架提供理论分析，并在具有挑战性的基准上验证我们的方法。
